title: Suffolk police release footage of Noah Woods as search for missing boy continues
summary_full: Hundreds of volunteers join hunt for three-year-old who went missing on Tuesday afternoonA massive search operation is under way in and around a Suffolk village for a missing three-year-old boy with autism, supported by hundreds of volunteers.Suffolk police have said the hunt for Noah Woods remains a missing persons investigation with no indication anything sinister has happened.
